spans.s:
ráti, f.
 —1. rest, quiet;
 —2. comfort,
pleasure. [√ram, 1157, cf. 954d.]

rātí, a. ready to give or bless; gracious;
as f. grace. [√1rā, ‘give.’]

rátna, n.
 —1. gift; blessing, riches,
treasure, as something bestowed or given
(cf. ratna-dhā́); so far Vedic;
 —2. postVedic:
precious stone, jewel, pearl; fig.,
as in Eng., jewel, i. e. the most excellent of
its kind. [√1rā, ‘bestow.’]
rātra, n. for rātri at end of cpds. [1315b.]

rā́trī, later rā́tri, f. night. [perhaps fr.
√ram, ‘rest.’]
